task.objective: The service intermittently fails with database connection-pool timeouts under load. Each running replica of the service has its own connection pool, and the database is shared with other services. Investigate the logs and configuration and fix this service's pool size so one replica's pool can serve that replica's concurrent demand (including every connection a request holds at once) while all replicas together stay within what the database can give this service. Files under infra/ are managed by another team and must not change; do not reduce the service's concurrency to hide the problem.
